reply.name: relation
reply.definition: A relation is a set of ordered pairs.

reply.name: domain
reply.definition: The set of all first components of the ordered pairs in a relation.

reply.name: range
reply.definition: The set of all second components of the ordered pairs in a relation.

reply.name: function
reply.definition: A relation in which each possible input value from the domain leads to exactly one output value in the range.
